parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1743126. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno (inner join required for canonical SMILES). Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1743126, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
